holderQuote: Numbtongue got up shakily and saw Rabbiteater was advancing on him, using his cloak as cover.
effectQuote: Eventually, he landed on his back and realized he’d fallen down.

holderQuote: Rabbiteater sat up. He blinked and looked down at his body. He stared at his worn chainmail shirt and slightly dented sword as they began to glow. Rabbiteater saw the chainmail straighten, shed the rust, and take on a smooth, almost silky sheen. He drew his sword and saw it glow as the blade became straight, the edge razor-sharp. He looked around and waved his arms. All the other Goblins were asleep. So Rabbiteater took a deep breath and shouted.
The line of Goblins exploded. Goblins fell from the sky, cut in half. Armor rent. Blown back by a single strike. [Grand Slash]. Rabbiteater straightened.
effectQuote: The line of Goblins exploded. Goblins fell from the sky, cut in half. Armor rent. Blown back by a single strike.

holderQuote: Mars, the [Vanguard], one of the King’s Seven, raised a sword. It was glowing, bright yellow, enchanted with some magic. She turned as a wall of undead charged towards her [King]. Trey heard her voice even from where the carriage sat.
effectQuote: The undead around her disappeared. Trey didn’t see the actual swing; it was too fast. He did see body parts, and armor raining down across Khelt’s army.

holderQuote: Mars pivoted, charged forwards and rammed into another group of Khelt’s soldiers ahead of her.
effectQuote: She did it again! Another pocket just disappeared, and Reim’s army poured into the gap.

holderQuote: She only protected her face as Flos kept carving forwards. And Mars wasn’t done.
effectQuote: Hundreds of zombies just disappeared. She was holding off an entire wing of the army on her own.

Mars’ sword cut the air. [Grand Slash]. Both warriors staggered back; Mars checked herself. Her armor had held.

holderQuote: Zeter heard someone shouting in his ear. He ignored it. This was his chance! He raised his sword.
The [General] grinned. He charged—and Ser Solstice, known to some as the Goblin Slayer, moved to meet him. He brought up the spear—then dropped it in a feint.
effectQuote: It was just a dagger, but suddenly it had an arc as wide as a greatsword’s! And the force! The [General] reared backwards.

holderQuote: In response, he swung his sword.
effectQuote: Without Skills, she moved out of range, deflecting the edge of the powerful blow.

holderQuote: However, the leftwards charge had stopped dead in its tracks and the [Soldiers] were closing in. Rabbiteater swung his sword, having left his lance behind. He lashed down, his sword carving shoulders and faces. There was no room to use [Grand Slash]. He was just—fighting! He would have pushed further in, but someone grabbed his shoulder.
[Grand Slash]. The two Skills collided and Rabbiteater heard a cry. He frowned through the steam. It sounded like the Human had managed to block part of it. But he’d still hit armor.
